reply: According to the University of Sargodha FAQ, regular admissions generally open in August or September. Admissions for Pharmacy, Medical and Allied Health Sciences generally open in October or November. These are usual periods, not a guarantee of the current admission deadline. Check the admission portal for the current session: https://admissions.su.edu.pk/

To apply to the University of Sargodha:
1. Open https://admissions.su.edu.pk/
2. Review the available degree programs and their eligibility requirements.
3. Complete the online application and follow the portal's instructions.
4. Pay the required application fee and upload the paid challan as instructed.
5. Check the admission portal for merit lists and updates.

Follow the current session's instructions because requirements and deadlines can vary.

Eligibility depends on the degree program you want to join. Visit https://admissions.su.edu.pk/programs to review program-specific qualifications and merit requirements. Tell me the program name, such as BS Computer Science, BS English, or BS Mathematics, so I can help explain what requirements you need to check.

University of Sargodha merit lists are published according to the admission schedule. Check the official merit portal at https://admissions.su.edu.pk/merits. Select your program and relevant merit list to check your status.

Yes. According to the University of Sargodha FAQ, applicants can apply for up to 8 programs of interest. Check the current admission portal for the applicable instructions and program eligibility: https://admissions.su.edu.pk/

UOS fees depend on your degree program and admission category, such as regular or self-support. You can view the official fee structure here: https://su.edu.pk/home/Prospectus/FeeStructure. Tell me your degree program, semester, and admission category if you need help identifying the relevant fee.

For a student admission or semester fee challan, follow the instructions in the relevant UOS student portal. For general university fee challans, visit https://www.uos.edu.pk/challan/general. If the challan system gives you trouble, the university's general challan page lists contact number 048-9230811-15, extension 7428.

The University of Sargodha FAQ describes these admission fee refund periods for semester/trimester programs: a full refund up to the 7th day after classes commence, a 50% refund from the 8th through 15th day, and no refund from the 16th day onward. Annual-system refund periods differ. Contact the university's fee section to confirm how the policy applies to your case.

The University of Sargodha provides scholarship information through its official scholarship page: https://su.edu.pk/scholarships. Check the available schemes, eligibility conditions, required documents, and application deadlines. Eligibility depends on the particular scholarship.

According to UOS hostel regulations, a hostel application must be completed and submitted to the admission office with the recommendation of the chairperson of your department. Hostel allotment is based on merit and eligibility, so it is not guaranteed. Read the official rules here: https://www.uos.edu.pk/public/office/hall-council/rules-regulations.

The University of Sargodha provides separate hostel facilities for male and female students. The official hostel directory lists facilities including Amna Hall, Ayesha Hall, Fatima Hall, Khadija Hall and Haleema Sadia Hall for female students, and Quaid-e-Azam Hall and Iqbal Hall for male students at the main campus. See https://uos.edu.pk/office/hall-council/hostels for the official directory.

Hostel charges can depend on the applicable accommodation and fee schedule. I don't have a verified current hostel fee amount in this chatbot's knowledge base. Contact UOS Hall Council or hostel administration for the current room, mess, and other charges. Official hostel information: https://uos.edu.pk/office/hall-council/hostels.

The University of Sargodha library provides access to books, journals, online databases and digital resources. For library membership, book borrowing, renewals and account-specific questions, contact the university library. Official student facilities information: https://www.uos.edu.pk/students.

Library opening hours may vary by day, semester and holidays. I don't have a verified current library timetable in this chatbot. Please confirm the current hours with the University of Sargodha library before visiting.

University office hours and class schedules can differ by department, program and day. Check your department's current timetable or contact the relevant office. This chatbot does not have a verified, university-wide daily timetable.

The University of Sargodha lists its general contact number as 048 111 867 111. Its address is University Road, Sargodha, Punjab, Pakistan, 40100. For a specific department, use the university's official website: https://www.uos.edu.pk/.
